Steps: Open the homepage on Desktop and Mobile.
Expected Result: Loads quickly, hero section is visible, layouts adjust properly to mobile screens without horizontal scroll.

Steps: Click "Create Free Invoice" on the homepage without logging in.
Expected Result: The free invoice generator tool loads. You can add items, totals calculate, and you can download a PDF.

Steps: Try to click "Save Invoice" while logged out.
Expected Result: A prompt appears asking you to sign up or log in to save and manage invoices.

Steps: View the pricing section. Toggle Monthly/Annual.
Expected Result: Prices update correctly. Annual shows default with savings badge.

Steps: Use a VPN (US/UK) and view pricing.
Expected Result: Prices display in USD instead of NGN.

Steps: Create a new account with email and password.
Expected Result: Account created, redirected to onboarding/dashboard.

Steps: Check inbox for verification link, click it.
Expected Result: Email is verified successfully.

Steps: Log in, close browser tab, reopen the app.
Expected Result: You remain logged in.

Steps: Attempt login with wrong password 5 times.
Expected Result: Clear error messages; account locks/rate-limits after max attempts.

Steps: Turn on 2FA in settings, logout, log back in.
Expected Result: Prompted for 6-digit code. Login blocked until correct code entered.

Steps: Click "Forgot Password", use reset link from email.
Expected Result: Password updates successfully, user can log in with new password.

Steps: View dashboard as a brand new user.
Expected Result: See the "Profile Strength" card and the "Get Started" Activation checklist.

Steps: Go to Settings/Profile. Update Business Name, Address, and Tax ID.
Expected Result: Saves successfully. Dashboard "Profile Strength" percentage increases.

Steps: Upload a company logo.
Expected Result: Upload succeeds, logo appears in settings and on new invoices.

Steps: Add Bank Name, Account Number, and Account Name.
Expected Result: Saves successfully. These appear automatically at the bottom of new invoices.

Steps: Set a default currency, default tax rate (e.g., 7.5% VAT), and default notes.
Expected Result: New invoices automatically load with these defaults applied.

Steps: Toggle public directory settings.
Expected Result: Saves successfully.

Steps: Create an invoice, add 3 line items with different quantities and rates.
Expected Result: Subtotal calculates exactly (Qty * Rate).

Steps: Apply a 10% discount and a 5% tax.
Expected Result: Total accurately reflects: (Subtotal - Discount) + Tax.

Steps: Click the client field. Add a brand new client. Then create a second invoice and search for that client.
Expected Result: New client saves to address book. Can be selected from dropdown on future invoices.

Steps: (Pro feature) Change invoice layout from Modern to Classic, Bold, etc.
Expected Result: Preview updates instantly reflecting the new structural layout.

Steps: Click "Save" without sending.
Expected Result: Invoice saves successfully, appears in invoice list with "Draft" status.

Steps: Create invoices until you hit 5 for the month. Try creating a 6th.
Expected Result: Creation blocked; usage meter shows 5/5; upgrade prompt appears.

Steps: Try to toggle document type to "Estimate" or "Credit Note".
Expected Result: Amber lock icon visible. Clicking redirects to /upgrade.

Steps: Try to select the Green, Purple, or Red themes.
Expected Result: Lock overlay visible. Clicking redirects to /upgrade.

Steps: Open the currency dropdown and select a non-free currency (e.g. JPY).
Expected Result: Option shows "· Pro". Clicking shows error toast and redirects to /upgrade.

Steps: Click "Send via email" in the success modal after saving.
Expected Result: Button is muted with a lock icon. Redirects to /upgrade.

Steps: Log into the GRANDFATHERED FREE account. Try to create >5 invoices, send emails, and make estimates.
Expected Result: Allowed. Grandfathered users retain their old 15 limit and legacy features.

Steps: Click "Download PDF".
Expected Result: PDF generates correctly, matches the web preview, formatting is intact.

Steps: Click "Send via email". Edit the subject and message. Send to a test email.
Expected Result: Email arrives formatted nicely, with PDF attached and a "View/Pay Invoice" button.

Steps: Copy the public link. Open in an Incognito window.
Expected Result: Client view loads correctly. Shows "Pay Now" button and invoice details.

Steps: As a client on the public link, click Pay Now. Complete test checkout.
Expected Result: Payment succeeds. Invoice status changes to "Paid" automatically.

Steps: Open an unpaid invoice. Click "Record Payment". Enter partial amount.
Expected Result: Invoice status changes to "Partially Paid". Remaining balance updates.

Steps: Set an invoice due date to yesterday.
Expected Result: Dashboard and invoice list flag it as "Overdue" in red.

Steps: Create an Estimate. Send via public link. "Client" clicks "Approve".
Expected Result: Estimate status changes to Approved.

Steps: Open an approved estimate. Click "Convert to Invoice".
Expected Result: New invoice is generated carrying over all line items and clients.

Steps: Create a Credit Note.
Expected Result: Generates properly with negative connotations/formatting.

Steps: Open an existing invoice. Click "Duplicate".
Expected Result: Creates a fresh draft invoice with identical line items and client info.

Steps: Create a $100 invoice, mark $50 as paid. Check dashboard.
Expected Result: Total revenue, Paid, and Unpaid tiles reflect the exact amounts accurately.

Steps: On a Free account, create an invoice and view the dashboard.
Expected Result: Meter increments correctly (e.g., 1/5 to 2/5).

Steps: Perform actions (create, send, mark paid). Check dashboard feed.
Expected Result: Recent Activity list logs these actions chronologically.

Steps: Go to Clients page. View list.
Expected Result: All previously added clients are listed.

Steps: Select a client, update their address and email.
Expected Result: Saves successfully. Future invoices reflect new address.

Steps: Click on a specific client profile.
Expected Result: Displays a history/ledger of all invoices specifically assigned to them.

Steps: Free user goes to /upgrade, selects Pro (Monthly), checks out via Paystack.
Expected Result: User is upgraded instantly. Editor locks are removed.

Steps: Admin opens User Management.
Expected Result: User shows "Pro" plan and "Active" status with correct expiry.

Steps: Cancel the subscription in the payment provider dashboard.
Expected Result: Access remains active until the end date, then reverts to Free plan.
